d: The Knicks defeated the Raptors, 111-102 tonight in Toronto. Jalen Brunson contributed a team-high 31 points to go with 5 rebounds 5 assists and 4 three pointers, with Mikal Bridges of the Knicks adding an additional 17 points (7-11 FG, 2-5 3P) in the game. Ja'Kobe Walter finished with a team-high 25 points along with 7 three pointers for the Raptors in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 8-6 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 5-9 for the season.
